newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Oct spot gas prices steady, traders wait.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Oct spot gas prices steady, traders wait.

text.p: U.S. spot natural gas prices for October notionally held steady again Friday, but activity was extremely thin as players waited for October flows to begin, industry sources said.
With demand expected to remain slack next week, few predicted a signifcant, early-month cash rally, even if the recent brisk pace of storage injections was maintained.
"There's been almost no load this week and none expected next week," said one cash trader.
October Gulf Coast gas was steady to up slightly in the mid-$1.80s/mmBtu, almost 10 cents over September indices.
But weekend gas at the Gulf cratered more than 10 cents to the low-$1.80s on mild East Coast weather.
October Midcon gas was talked little changed in the low-to-mid $1.70s, still almost 10 cents over Sept indices.
In south Texas, gas for October delivery notionally was flat from Thursday in the mid-to-high $1.70s, steady to slightly over index.
In west Texas, October gas on El Paso Permian fell a couple of cents to the mid-to-high $1.60s, still a couple of cents above Sept 1 levels.
October New York city gate gas again firmed a few cents to near the $2.20 level.
